```{r}

dir <- "~/Partners HealthCare Dropbox/Ning Guan/Lab Work- Alexa Mitchell/ATAC-seq CUTnRUN/BPPNM Rela Stat3 CUTnRUN"
```

```{r}
# Peak annotation using CHIPseeker
all_peaks <- list.files(path = file.path(dir,"macs2"), pattern = "rmBL_filtered_p8", full.names = TRUE)
peak_list <- lapply(all_peaks, readPeakFile)
annotate_list <- lapply(peak_list,function(peak){
  annotatePeak(peak, TxDb=TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene)
})

names(annotate_list) <- c("Int2_IL6_Stat3","Int2_Rela","Int2_Stat3","Int2_TNFa_Rela","RelaKO_Rela","RelaKO_TNFa_Rela","Stat3KO_IL6_Stat3","Stat3KO_Stat3")
annotate_list <- annotate_list[c("Int2_Rela","Int2_TNFa_Rela","RelaKO_Rela","RelaKO_TNFa_Rela","Int2_Stat3","Int2_IL6_Stat3","Stat3KO_Stat3","Stat3KO_IL6_Stat3")]
plotAnnoBar(annotate_list)
```


```{r}
# GO enrichment analysis using rGREAT
int2_tnfa_rela <- peak_list[[4]]
h_gene_sets = msigdbr(species="Mus musculus",category = "H")
h_gene_sets = split(h_gene_sets$entrez_gene, h_gene_sets$gs_name)
h_gene_sets = lapply(h_gene_sets, as.character)
res_int2_tnfa_rela <- great(int2_tnfa_rela,h_gene_sets,"txdb:mm10",mode='oneClosest')
plotRegionGeneAssociations(res_int2_tnfa_rela)
```
```{r}
int2_tnfa_rela_tb <- getEnrichmentTable(res_int2_tnfa_rela)
head(int2_tnfa_rela_tb, 10) %>% dplyr::select(id, genome_fraction, observed_region_hits, fold_enrichment,mean_tss_dist,p_adjust_hyper) %>% datatable(elementId = "GO_Int2_TNFa_Rela")
```

```{r}
# Cebpb - Rela overlap or nearby peaks
int2_rela_cebpb_10kb <- readPeakFile(file.path(dir,"macs2/Rela_Cebpb/Int2_TNFa_Rela_rmKO_intersect_Cebpb_Stim_10kb.narrowPeak"))
anno_rela_cebpb_10kb <- annotatePeak(int2_rela_cebpb_10kb, TxDb=TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene)
# Examine gene set unique to Int2_Stim_Cebpb peaks 
anno_rela_10kb_df <- as.data.frame(as.GRanges(anno_rela_cebpb_10kb))
anno_rela_10kb_df$geneSymbol <- mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, keys = as.character(anno_rela_10kb_df$geneId), column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENTREZID", multiVals = "first")
write.table(anno_rela_10kb_df,file.path(dir,"Analysis/anno_rela_cebpb_10kb_df.txt"),sep="\t",quote=F,row.names = F)
rela_cebpb_10kb_genes <- unique(anno_rela_10kb_df$geneSymbol)
```

```{r}
# Get gene lists for each pathway 
res_int2_cebpb_tnfa <- as.data.frame(getRegionGeneAssociations(res_int2_stim_cebpb, term_id="HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB"))
res_int2_cebpb_hypoxia <- as.data.frame(getRegionGeneAssociations(res_int2_stim_cebpb, term_id="HALLMARK_HYPOXIA"))
res_int2_cebpb_il2 <- as.data.frame(getRegionGeneAssociations(res_int2_stim_cebpb, term_id="HALLMARK_IL2_STAT5_SIGNALING"))
res_int2_cebpb_il6 <- as.data.frame(getRegionGeneAssociations(res_int2_stim_cebpb, term_id="HALLMARK_IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING"))
res_int2_cebpb_tnfa$pathway <- "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB"
res_int2_cebpb_hypoxia$pathway <- "HALLMARK_HYPOXIA"
res_int2_cebpb_il2$pathway <- "HALLMARK_IL2_STAT5_SIGNALING"
res_int2_cebpb_il6$pathway <- "HALLMARK_IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING"
res_int2_rela_cebpb_genes <- rbind(res_int2_cebpb_tnfa,res_int2_cebpb_il6,res_int2_cebpb_il2,res_int2_cebpb_hypoxia)
res_int2_rela_cebpb_genes$annotated_genes <- as.character(res_int2_rela_cebpb_genes$annotated_genes)
res_int2_rela_cebpb_genes$dist_to_TSS <- as.character(res_int2_rela_cebpb_genes$dist_to_TSS)
res_int2_cebpb_genes_promoter <- res_int2_cebpb_genes[abs(as.numeric(res_int2_cebpb_genes$dist_to_TSS)) < 3000,]
write.table(res_int2_cebpb_genes_promoter,file.path(dir,"Analysis/Int2_TNFa_Rela_Promoter_Pathways.txt"),sep="\t",quote=F,row.names = F)
```
```{r}
# Make Heatmap 
peaks_heatmap <- function(res_int2_cebpb_il6){
il6_table <- as.data.frame(table(as.character(res_int2_cebpb_il6$annotated_genes)))
il6_table <- il6_table[order(il6_table$Freq, decreasing = T),]
rownames(il6_table) <- il6_table$Var1
il6_table <- il6_table[-c(1)]
pheatmap(il6_table,cluster_rows = F,cluster_cols = F,fontsize=8,color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "red"))(50))#,breaks=seq(-15,15,length.out=50))
}
peaks_heatmap(res_int2_cebpb_il6)
```
# Chi-squared test for independence
```{r}
contingency <- matrix(c(849,290,6094,12767),nrow=2,byrow=T)
contingency <- matrix(c(5049,587,6389,12503),nrow=2,byrow=T) # 24528 total genes
contingency <- matrix(c(4490,1137,4601,14300),nrow=2,byrow=T)
dimnames(contingency) <- list(
  Rela = c("Target", "NotTarget"),
  Cebpb = c("Target", "NotTarget")
)
contingency
f <- fisher.test(contingency, alternative = "two.sided")
chi <- chisq.test(contingency)
```

```{r}
dir <- "~/Partners HealthCare Dropbox/Ning Guan/Lab Work- Alexa Mitchell/ATAC-seq CUTnRUN/BPPNM Cebpb Rela CUTnRUN"
```
```{r}
# Peak annotation using CHIPseeker
all_peaks <- list.files(path = file.path(dir,"macs2_final"), pattern = "rmBL_filtered", full.names = TRUE)
file_names <- list.files(path = file.path(dir,"macs2_final"), pattern = "rmBL_filtered", full.names = F)
sample_names <- sub("_dedup_peaks_rmBL_filtered_p8.narrowPeak", "", file_names)
sample_names <- sub("_dedup_peaks_rmBL_filtered_p15.narrowPeak", "", sample_names)
peak_list <- lapply(all_peaks, readPeakFile)
num_peaks <- lapply(peak_list,length)
num_peaks <- unlist(num_peaks)
annotate_list <- lapply(peak_list,function(peak){
  annotatePeak(peak, TxDb=TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene)
})

names(annotate_list) <- sample_names
sample_order <- c("Int2_Cebpb","CebpbKO_Cebpb","Int2_TNF_Cebpb",
                  "Int2_TNF_IFNg_Cebpb","CebpbKO_TNF_IFNg_Cebpb",
                  "Int2_Rela","RelaKO_Rela","Int2_TNF_Rela","RelaKO_TNF_Rela",
                  "Int2_TNF_IFNg_Rela","RelaKO_TNF_IFNg_Rela")
annotate_list <- annotate_list[sample_order]
plotAnnoBar(annotate_list)
```
```{r}
# Number of peaks
num_peaks_df <- read.xlsx(file.path(dir,"Analysis/peak_numbers.xlsx"),rowNames = T,sheet="Peaks")
#num_peaks_df <- data.frame(Samples = sample_names, Peaks = num_peaks)
num_peaks_df$Samples = factor(num_peaks_df$Samples,levels=sample_order)
num_peaks_df %>% ggplot(aes(x = Samples, y = Peaks, fill = Samples)) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity") +
    geom_jitter(width=0.1) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
    ylim(c(0,NA))+
    theme(plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5),axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.5,hjust=0.5),axis.title.x=element_blank(),legend.position="none")+
    ylab("# of Signifiant Peaks") +
    xlab("") +
    ggtitle("Peak number after de-duplication")
write.table(num_peaks_df,file.path(dir,"Analysis/peak_numbers.txt"),sep="\t",row.names = T)
```

4. Plot heatmaps of Il6-Stat3 and TNFa via NF-kB pathways
```{r}
int2_tnf_ifng_cebpb <- peak_list[[4]]
res_int2_tnf_ifng_cebpb <- great(int2_tnf_ifng_cebpb,h_gene_sets,"txdb:mm10",mode='oneClosest')
# Get gene lists for each pathway 
res_int2_cebpb_il6 <- as.data.frame(getRegionGeneAssociations(res_int2_tnf_ifng_cebpb, term_id="HALLMARK_IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING"))
res_int2_cebpb_tnfa <- as.data.frame(getRegionGeneAssociations(res_int2_tnf_ifng_cebpb, term_id="HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB"))
res_int2_cebpb_il6$pathway <- "HALLMARK_IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING"
res_int2_cebpb_tnfa$pathway <- "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB"
res_int2_tnf_ifng_cebpb_genes <- rbind(res_int2_cebpb_il6,res_int2_cebpb_tnfa)

res_int2_cebpb_tgfb <- as.data.frame(getRegionGeneAssociations(res_int2_tnf_cebpb, term_id="HALLMARK_TGF_BETA_SIGNALING"))
res_int2_cebpb_tgfb_promoter <- res_int2_cebpb_tgfb[abs(as.numeric(res_int2_cebpb_tgfb$dist_to_TSS)) < 3000,]
tnf_cebpb_tgfb_genes <- unique(as.character(res_int2_cebpb_tgfb_promoter$annotated_genes))

res_int2_tnf_ifng_cebpb_genes$annotated_genes <- as.character(res_int2_tnf_ifng_cebpb_genes$annotated_genes)
res_int2_tnf_ifng_cebpb_genes$dist_to_TSS <- as.character(res_int2_tnf_ifng_cebpb_genes$dist_to_TSS)
res_int2_tnf_ifng_cebpb_genes_promoter <- res_int2_tnf_ifng_cebpb_genes[abs(as.numeric(res_int2_tnf_ifng_cebpb_genes$dist_to_TSS)) < 3000,]
write.table(res_int2_tnf_ifng_cebpb_genes,file.path(dir,"Analysis/Int2_TNF_IFNg_Cebpb_Pathways.txt"),sep="\t",quote=F,row.names = F)
```

```{r}
# Make Heatmap 
peaks_heatmap <- function(res_int2_cebpb_il6){
il6_table <- as.data.frame(table(as.character(res_int2_cebpb_il6$annotated_genes)))
il6_table <- il6_table[il6_table$Var1 != 'c(`14825` = "Cxcl1", `20310` = "Cxcl2")',]
il6_table <- il6_table[order(il6_table$Freq, decreasing = T),]
rownames(il6_table) <- il6_table$Var1
il6_table <- il6_table[-c(1)]
pheatmap(il6_table,cluster_rows = F,cluster_cols = F,fontsize=8,color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "red"))(50))#,breaks=seq(-15,15,length.out=50))
}
peaks_heatmap(res_int2_cebpb_rela_il6)
```

```{r}
overlap_rela_cebpb_genes <- intersect(tnf_ifng_rela_promoter_genes,tnf_ifng_cebpb_promoter_genes)
```

```{r}
# Convert human symbols to list of mouse symbols
matchMMUsymbol<-function(human_symbol){
  dir = "~/Partners HealthCare Dropbox/Ning Guan/Documents/Code/codes_Davis"
	map=read.table(file.path(dir,'src/Mouse_Human_GeneIDs_sub.txt'),sep=' ',header=T)
	map_sor<-map[match(human_symbol,map$hsa_symbol),]
	mouse<-map_sor$mmu_symbol
	return(mouse)
}
```
